sourceEvidence: Sable ServerSubLevel prePhysicsTick evaluates BlockSubLevelLiftProvider contributions on each physics substep and separately tracks attached contraption/body forces.
Sable individual queued-force tracking records drag point forces through ForceGroups.DRAG and QueuedForceGroup.getRecordedPointForces().
simulated:white_symmetric_sail has lift scalar 0 and parallel drag scalar 1.75; its aerodynamic authority is therefore tested as deflected drag rather than generic lift.
The v0.14 Swivel command path remains the source of target deflection; v0.15 does not directly write targetAngleDegrees.
